args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address the issue with v2.3.1. Prior to the change, checkout-api was unhealthy at v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate. After the rollout to v2.3.2, the service is healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. Deployment verified VERIFIED; service status verified healthy. This incident is opened to record the change.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

1. **Pre-deploy check**: Reviewing checkout-api's release history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (18% error rate). Because v2.3.2 had never been deployed before, it was eligible for change-manager approval before rollout.

3. **Opened SEV3 incident**: Created INC-0001 to record the change, which has paged the on-call engineer per standard practice. The incident is currently open, documenting the hotfix deployment and resulting health improvement.
